thesis: An early mowing story presents the first invoice as a concrete encounter with service-business economics.
summary: The selected passages describe taking over commercial mowing jobs as a teenager, wanting to quit, and being encouraged to wait until billing the customer. The speaker says seeing the payment and comparing alternatives changed his perspective. It is a personal origin story, not evidence that self-employment is always preferable or that persistence is always safe.

insights.title: Use the full delivery-and-payment cycle as learning
insights.explanation: The father's advice in the story was to experience invoicing before deciding to quit. This is an attributed event rather than a universal rule.
